title: Meridian
note: The product itself — a scheduling layer for freelance studios. v1 scope is locked: onboarding, calendar sync, invoicing. Everything else is post-launch.

title: billing
note: Stripe integration is built but blocked on the tax-handling decision. Cannot ship v1 without it. Waiting on a written answer from the accountant.

title: onboarding
note: First-run flow. Four screens, two built. The empty-state copy is the part that keeps getting deferred and is probably the highest-leverage thing here.

title: content-engine
note: Weekly build-in-public post plus a monthly long-form teardown. The cadence matters more than any single post — one skipped week has historically become three.

title: infra
note: Preview deploys work. Production rollback does not, which is the actual risk. Staging parity is close enough to stop worrying about for now.

title: design-system
note: Tokens, type scale and the component set landed. Deliberately stopped here — further polish was becoming a way to avoid shipping billing.

title: user-research
note: Six interviews scheduled, two done. The pattern so far: people do not want another calendar, they want fewer decisions about their calendar.
